answer_1.quote: ...we conduct experiments on two dialogue datasets, OpenSubtitles and DailyDialog, to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach...

answer_2.quote: ...we evaluate the diversity of generated responses by calculating the number of distinct unigrams, bigrams, and trigrams in generated responses... The value is scaled by the total number of generated tokens... We also adopt the approach ... which measures the increases in perplexity when the model is fed with perturbed dialogue history...

answer_4.quote: ...we invite 20 human annotators which are all graduate students with good English proficiency to evaluate the quality of the model... evaluate the fluency, consistency, and diversity of the model (scored between 1-5)...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators interacted with each model for 50 utterances and rated fluency, consistency, and diversity on a 1–5 scale.
